Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football GPL 2026/2027: Aduana beat Berekum Chelsea to go 4th Source : Daniel Koranteng 1 November 2026 5:26pm Audio By Carbonatix
Stephen Amankona’s brace was enough to earn Aduana FC all three points in their matchday nine clash against Berekum Chelsea.
The former Berekum Chelsea forward fired either side of the break to seal a 2-0 win for Aduana.
The Dormaa based side are up to 4th on the table, two points behind league leaders Medeama, while Berekum Chelsea slump to 11th.
